fusion_T20.note: Fusion Hit@10 for a partner equals the stored fusion_hit10 on the query where that partner is designated; shortlist fusion order is human-specific and independent of designation.

definition.known_positives: Evaluation-file positive viral partners of the query human (HVIDB test / IntAct cross-test positives), not training-only partners.
definition.designated_positive: The single labelled true partner of the pair-level query; primary protocol for Table 2 and the Hit@K = Recall@T × oracle@K identity.
definition.any_known_positive_hit@K: 1 if at least one evaluation-file positive partner of the query human has Stage-1 rank ≤ K (or fusion/direct Hit@10 membership for those arms).
